rounds.text: Asston Pharmaceuticals demonstrates a robust long-term growth trajectory, evidenced by a 57% compounded sales growth and 55% compounded profit growth over the last three years [E14, E16]. The company maintains a strong capital structure with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.13x and has actively reduced its total borrowings [E28, E29, E40]. Investors are rewarded by a proven track record of capital efficiency, highlighted by a 3-year median ROE of 26% and a current ROCE of 17.0% [E12, E20, E41]. Furthermore, the company is positioned within a sector experiencing positive tailwinds, and its valuation remains attractive relative to the sector benchmark with an EV/EBITDA of 11.88x compared to the 16.24x average [E11, E55]. Conceded: the company faces significant operational challenges, including negative operating and free cash flow in March 2026, a decline in promoter holding, and high debtor days [E26, E27, E31, E46]. Despite these headwinds, the current market price remains supported by a discounted cash flow valuation, suggesting the market has yet to fully price in the company's multi-year growth potential [E34, E50, E51].
